description: Inline status indicator that shows whether a form has unsaved changes, is currently saving, or has been saved. Supports an optional auto-save timer that fires a callback after a configurable interval when unsaved changes are present. Exposes MarkUnsaved() and MarkSaved() methods for manual control.

parameters.name: IsEnabled
parameters.description: When false, the auto-save timer is stopped and no automatic saves are triggered.

parameters.name: AutoSaveIntervalSeconds
parameters.description: Interval in seconds between automatic save attempts. Only applies when IsEnabled is true.

parameters.name: OnSave
parameters.description: Callback invoked by the auto-save timer when unsaved changes are present. Use this to persist data.

publicMethods.name: MarkUnsaved()
publicMethods.description: Transitions the indicator to the Unsaved state. Call this whenever the user modifies form data.

publicMethods.name: MarkSaved()
publicMethods.description: Transitions the indicator to the Saved state. Call this after a successful manual save.

examples.title: Basic usage with auto-save
examples.code:
<TmAutoSaveIndicator @ref="_autoSave" OnSave="HandleAutoSave" />

@code {
    private TmAutoSaveIndicator _autoSave = default!;

    private async Task HandleAutoSave()
    {
        await SaveFormAsync();
    }

    private void OnFormChanged()
    {
        _autoSave.MarkUnsaved();
    }
}
